description.text: Objective: Through one semester study, students could learn business etiquette, be familiar with business practice, improve the ability of using business Chinese and apply or carry out business work with what you have learnt during class. Characteristics: Analog business class & small size & practice teaching Courses: Practical Chinese Listening and Reading, Practical Comprehensive Chinese, Daily Chinese Conversation, Business Chinese Listening, Business Chinese Reading, Business Correspondence, Lecture on Enterprize Culture and Cooperation of Chinese and Foreign Companies etc. Notes: The program will open if the number of applicants are over 10 or above. It could accept group and individual registration. Group class could decide the study content and study time.

duration.text: The Business Chinese Program at Ludong University is a 1 Semester long program for international students, taught in Chinese.

fees.text: Application Fee: $ 150 USD Service Fee: $ 50 USD Tuition fee: $ 1180 USD/per semester ￥ 8500 CNY/per semester

materials.text: 1. Photocopy of valid passport With photo, passport number &expiration date and name included. 2. Passport-sized photo A passport-sized photo taken recently of the applicant. 3.Certificate of HSK If applicable. Certificate of HSK (Chinese Proficiency Test), No need for English medium programs

requirements.text: (Applicants must be) non-Chinese citizens with a valid passport New HSK Level 4 or above
